understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by positioning every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked with a '+' so that all goals are simultaneously occupied, which triggers a WIN and allows progression through all levels until the final win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Moves were made with directional actions (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) for the currently selected piece, respecting walls/obstacles that block movement; pushing could occur only when the rules allowed (otherwise movement was prevented). When multiple selectable pieces existed, a CLICK action on a piece’s coordinates switched/teleported selection to that piece’s position (i.e., moving the selected piece to the clicked piece’s location), enabling repositioning/selection changes under a limited step budget per level.
